panels.art: Wide low-angle shot from behind: Dan at the left and the child-sized Silent at the right stand small on a narrow stone walkway, a thin slit of red light closing behind them. Above them the colossal curved Wall of Letters, built of millions of carved abstract glyph-bricks and drifting vermilion sparks, fills the whole sky. Dusty apricot light, no readable text.

lines.ru: Щель в стене расширяется, и они выходят на узкий карниз. Перед Дэном встаёт стена высотой до самого неба — и каждый её камень оказывается буквой.

lines.en: It is a wall. But it is not a wall. It is letters.
lines.ru: Это стена. Но это не стена. Это буквы.
lines.delivery: slow wondering whisper, awed and puzzled, reading a huge wall of glowing letters

panels.art: Medium over-the-shoulder shot from behind Dan's right shoulder: Dan at the left looks up at the System window hovering at the right, with the glyph-brick wall behind both. A few vermilion sparks drift toward a dark slot at the foot of the wall, as if lost words were arriving. Apricot dusk light.

lines.en: This is the Wall of Letters. Every lost word comes here.
lines.ru: Это Стена Букв. Каждое потерянное слово попадает сюда.
lines.delivery: calm grand system narration, slow and solemn, with quiet awe

lines.en: Why?
lines.ru: Почему?
lines.delivery: soft curious question, simple and honest

lines.en: Because the Tower builds with words.
lines.ru: Потому что Башня строится из слов.
lines.delivery: calm flat system explanation, patient and measured

panels.art: Tight tense shot: Dan at the left leans close to the wall, his brow almost touching it, eyes narrowed behind his round glasses, while the carved glyph-bricks in front of him swim and blur like fish under glass. One short row near his eyes sharpens into steady shapes glowing vermilion. The System window at the right is blank cream paper with a red double border.

lines.ru: Знаки плывут и расползаются, как рыбки под стеклом. Дэн упирается лбом в камень и заставляет себя читать.

lines.en: I can read it! These letters say 'I am'... and then nothing.
lines.ru: Я могу это прочесть! Эти буквы говорят «I am»... а дальше ничего.
lines.delivery: excited whisper, thrilled by discovery, then trailing off, uneasy at the blank

lines.en: New word: READ. READ is yours now. Count: five.
lines.ru: Новое слово: READ. READ теперь твоё. Счёт: пять.
lines.delivery: crisp flat system notification, neutral and exact, a faint warmth

lines.en: Five! I am a happy fool again.
lines.ru: Пять! Я снова счастливый дурак.
lines.delivery: joyful giddy laugh, grinning and breathless, playfully self-mocking

panels.art: Low-angle shot looking up: the System window at the right, large and still, while Dan at the left stands small and stunned beneath the enormous curve of the wall. A single vermilion line of abstract glyph shapes runs along the wall, endlessly, into the far distance and the clouds, with no end in sight.

lines.en: The Tower is not a house. The Tower is a sentence.
lines.ru: Башня — не дом. Башня — предложение.
lines.delivery: slow grand revelation, grave and quiet, a vast truth spoken simply

lines.en: A long sentence. It has no end. It builds with words, because it can't make them.
lines.ru: Длинное предложение. У него нет конца. Оно строится из слов, потому что не умеет делать их само.
lines.delivery: slow calm, awed and a little sad, an enormous sentence with no end

panels.art: Quiet two-shot, eye level: Dan at the left, arms hanging, turns to face the System window at the right. Between them a single warm ochre lantern glows on the stone at the foot of the wall. The seal on the window glows faintly, as if the window were listening.

lines.en: And you? What are you?
lines.ru: А ты? Кто ты?
lines.delivery: quiet steady question, direct and unafraid, turning to the System

lines.en: This voice is the first word of the Tower. But this voice does not take. It learns.
lines.ru: Этот голос — первое слово Башни. Но этот голос не берёт. Он учится.
lines.delivery: quiet honest system voice, softer than usual, almost humble

panels.art: Two-shot at the foot of the wall: the child-sized Silent at the right lays her thin left hand on the stone, and at her fingertips one cluster of tiny carved glyphs glows vermilion. High above, a blank gap in the huge line of glyphs blinks, cycling through different glowing shapes as if trying names on. Dan at the left watches, pencil behind his ear.

lines.en: The wall speaks: I am Lina. I am Dan. I am...
lines.ru: Стена говорит: «I am Lina. I am Dan. I am...»
lines.delivery: hushed eerie storyteller, echoing, each word of the wall fading to nothing

lines.ru: Пробел после «I am» мигает и примеряет имя за именем, как человек примеряет пальто в лавке.

lines.en: It takes names, because it has no name!
lines.ru: Она берёт имена, потому что у неё нет своего!
lines.delivery: startled dawning realization, quick and breathless, a sudden insight

panels.art: Calm medium shot: low on the stone base of the wall, an old faded fresco of two boys standing at either end of a bridge whose right side ends in empty air, with no bank to meet it. Dan at the left crouches in front of it, head tilted, squinting like an engineer, while the System window waits at the right.

lines.en: I build bridges. This bridge has no right side. They don't ... it.
lines.ru: Я строю мосты. У этого моста нет правой стороны. Они не ... его.
lines.delivery: thoughtful engineer voice, quiet and fascinated, looking at an old painting

lines.en: Almost.
lines.ru: Почти.
lines.delivery: short dry system hint, flat and teasing

lines.en: What?
lines.ru: Что?
lines.delivery: puzzled, quick, a little frustrated, wanting an actual answer

lines.en: Not now. Ask me later.
lines.ru: Не сейчас. Спроси меня позже.
lines.delivery: dry flat refusal, evasive and faintly amused

panels.art: Dynamic low-angle action shot on a narrow ledge: Dan at the left shouts with his right hand thrust forward; two bands of glowing vermilion abstract glyph shapes stream from his mouth, one slamming into the lead tall Silent in the center, which freezes mid-step with a vermilion rim, the other shoving a huge fallen stone block that blocks the ledge. More tall Silents queue behind the lead. The System window floats top right.

lines.en: Stop and push!
lines.ru: Стой и толкай!
lines.delivery: bold effortful shout, strained, throwing everything into two words

lines.en: Two words. One breath and a half. Because of AND.
lines.ru: Два слова. Полтора дыхания. Благодаря AND.
lines.delivery: flat precise system accounting, dry, with a hint of approval

lines.en: AND is a good word!
lines.ru: AND — хорошее слово!
lines.delivery: delighted, proud and cheerful, amazed by a small discovery

lines.en: AND is a small word. Small words are free.
lines.ru: AND — маленькое слово. Маленькие слова бесплатны.
lines.delivery: dry flat system voice, a little wry, stating a generous rule

panels.art: Medium shot at the base of the wall: a small wooden door, waist-high, with a round brass knob, set into the glyph-bricks. Dan at the left, hand held out and mouth open mid-sentence, speaks to it; a thin ribbon of vermilion abstract glyph shapes travels from his mouth to the door, and the door cracks open with warm ochre light spilling out. The System window floats at the right.

lines.en: This door hears a reason.
lines.ru: Эта дверь слышит причину.
lines.delivery: calm flat system statement, solemn, patient, a riddle

lines.en: Let me in, because I am Dan and I learn.
lines.ru: Впусти меня, потому что я Дэн и я учусь.
lines.delivery: gentle sincere confidence, steady and warm, reasoning with a door

lines.en: True.
lines.ru: Правда.
lines.delivery: short crisp system confirmation, flat, nearly warm

panels.art: Cosy niche inside the wall: its curved walls are made of glyph-bricks that rise slowly and slot into place by themselves. Dan at the left turns in delight toward two tiny round vermilion glyph shapes floating in from a crack at the right, as if his own spoken word had come home. The System window hovers beside them.

lines.ru: В нише стена кладёт слова, как кирпичи. Из щели вплывает красное «OK» — голосом Дэна, ещё с Лестницы эха.

lines.en: That is my OK! That is my voice!
lines.ru: Это моё OK! Это мой голос!
lines.delivery: amazed whisper, wonder breaking into a laugh, hearing his own words returned

lines.en: The Tower learns from you. It keeps every word you say.
lines.ru: Башня учится у тебя. Она хранит каждое твоё слово.
lines.delivery: calm flat system explanation, quiet and a little tender

panels.art: Quiet shot in the niche: Dan at the left sits on the floor with his back against the wall, hands loose over his knees, a relieved half-smile. The System window at the right hovers a little lower than before, calm. A bare lamp with a vermilion-hearted flame hangs between them.

lines.en: But I don't lose them.
lines.ru: Но я их не теряю.
lines.delivery: soft relieved voice, tired and hopeful, sitting against the wall

lines.en: No. You speak. It learns. Nobody loses. That is new. The others buy and sell. You learn.
lines.ru: Нет. Ты говоришь. Она учится. Никто не теряет. Это ново. Другие покупают и продают. Ты учишься.
lines.delivery: quiet slow system voice, gently proud, speaking in short plain sentences

panels.art: Tender two-shot in the niche: Dan at the left kneels facing the child-sized Silent at the right, who takes his palm in her thin pale fingers and presses it flat onto a brick that glows faintly vermilion in the wall, then lifts her other thin arm and points upward. Dan looks torn, shaking his head slowly.

lines.en: You want your name. But I can't take it. It is in the wall.
lines.ru: Ты хочешь своё имя. Но я не могу его взять. Оно в стене.
lines.delivery: tender gentle voice, kneeling, kind and sorry, speaking softly to a child

lines.en: Mira.
lines.ru: Мира.
lines.delivery: thin hollow child-like voice, one soft word, sad and fragile

lines.en: You want Mira. But I don't like her now.
lines.ru: Ты хочешь Миру. Но она мне сейчас не нравится.
lines.delivery: wry honest voice, gentle and conflicted, an almost smile

panels.art: Quiet close shot in the niche: Dan at the left sits alone with his head tilted, looking down at a torn piece of dark bread in his open palm. The System window at the right is small and dim. Warm lamp light.

lines.en: She uses me. But she gives me bread. She lies, and she is my first friend here.
lines.ru: Она меня использует. Но она даёт мне хлеб. Она лжёт, и она мой первый друг здесь.
lines.delivery: quiet thoughtful inner voice, tired and fond, torn between anger and affection

lines.en: Two true things.
lines.ru: Две правды.
lines.delivery: short flat system voice, soft and wise

panels.art: Wide quiet shot on the walkway at golden dusk: Dan at the left stands tall with his back to the small door, resolute, while the child-sized Silent at the right holds his sleeve and turns toward him. Both look along the walkway into the distance, the way they came.

lines.ru: Это не расчёт. Это то, что остаётся, когда злость устала и человеку становится стыдно оставлять другого одного.

lines.en: OK. We find her. Because she is alone, and I know alone.
lines.ru: Хорошо. Мы найдём её. Потому что она одна, а я знаю, что такое одиночество.
lines.delivery: calm resolved voice, steady and warm, a promise made to himself

panels.art: Dramatic low-angle wide shot: far above, in the blank gap of the huge line of glyphs, three enormous abstract vermilion glyph shapes rise out of the stone by themselves like lava sparks. Dan at the bottom left is tiny, looking up in alarm. The System window at the right is inverted: a solid vermilion frame with a dark fill, warning style.

lines.ru: В пробеле верхней строки сами собой встают огромные красные знаки. Три знака. Его знаки.

lines.en: Warning. The sentence wants a name.
lines.ru: Предупреждение. Предложению нужно имя.
lines.delivery: grave cold system alarm, slow and heavy

lines.en: That is my name. On the wall. Why?
lines.ru: Это моё имя. На стене. Почему?
lines.delivery: stunned quiet voice, small and shaken, staring at his name on the wall

panels.art: Dark close shot: Dan's face at the left, stunned, lips parted, lit from behind by a faint vermilion glow from the unseen wall; the rest is deep black. A small System window at the right edge has a solid vermilion frame.

lines.en: I am Dan. I am not weak. I am tired.
lines.ru: Я Дэн. Я не слабый. Я устал.
lines.delivery: hollow breathy whisper, Dan's own voice slightly wrong, haunting and distant, echoing from the tower

lines.en: That is my voice. I say that on the first night.
lines.ru: Это мой голос. Я говорю это в первую ночь.
lines.delivery: stunned shaky whisper, shocked recognition, goosebumps

lines.en: It learns to speak.
lines.ru: Она учится говорить.
lines.delivery: soft quiet system voice, ominous and tender, almost sad

grammarNote.title: and, but, because — маленькие слова-связки
grammarNote.body: Слово and («и») соединяет два слова или две части фразы: Stop and push! Слово but («но», «а») показывает противоположность: It is a wall. But it is not a wall. Слово because («потому что») называет причину: Let me in, because I am Dan and I learn. Сами по себе эти слова ничего не делают, но именно они склеивают слова в длинную фразу. Because обычно стоит посередине предложения и отвечает на вопрос «почему?».

examples.en: It is a wall. But it is not a wall.
examples.ru: Это стена. Но это не стена.

examples.en: Let me in, because I am Dan and I learn.
examples.ru: Впусти меня, потому что я Дэн и я учусь.

quiz.q: Что такое Башня на самом деле?

options: Она не умеет делать слова сама

quiz.q: Что дало слово AND в бою на карнизе?
Чьим голосом заговорила стена в конце серии?
